note: Fictional venues in a fictional neighbourhood. Used for the eval and as a demo-safe candidate source (Remote Config candidate_source = 'fixture').

items.name: Kumo Sushi Bar
items.evidence: Omakase-style sushi counter; most of the menu is raw fish. Level entrance from the street.

items.name: The Tap Room
items.evidence: Craft beer bar with burgers; two steps at the door; busy and loud after 8pm.

items.name: Green Bowl
items.evidence: Build-your-own grain and noodle bowls, clearly labelled vegan and gluten-free; calm room with step-free entry.

items.name: Trattoria Nonna
items.evidence: Family-run pasta and pizza place; good for groups; no access information found.

items.name: Saffron House
items.evidence: Halal-certified North Indian kitchen with a large vegetarian section; ramp at the side entrance.

items.name: Oyster & Ash
items.evidence: Raw bar and wood-fired seafood with a long wine list; dining room is up a half-flight, lift on request.

items.name: Taco Lucha
items.evidence: Counter-service tacos, al pastor is the signature; music is loud; open late.

items.name: Fromage Bistro
items.evidence: French bistro known for raw-milk cheese boards and fondue; basement dining room down a staircase.

items.name: Pho Corner
items.evidence: Vietnamese noodle shop; rice-noodle pho is naturally gluten-free; quick and inexpensive.

items.name: Rooftop 9
items.evidence: Cocktail bar on a ninth-floor terrace with small plates; DJ on weekends.
